act.name: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023
act.source_name: Official Gazette of India / India Code
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: The law of evidence in India. Replaced the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 on 1 July 2024.

sections.title: Admissibility of electronic records
sections.chapter: Chapter V - Of Oral and Documented Evidence
sections.text:
(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in this Adhiniyam, any information contained in an electronic record which is printed on a paper, stored, recorded or copied in optical or magnetic media or produced by a computer... shall be deemed to be also a document... and shall be admissible in any proceedings, without further proof or production of the original.
(4) In any proceedings where it is desired to give a statement in evidence by virtue of this section, a certificate doing any of the following things shall be produced, namely: identifying the electronic record containing the statement... signed by a person occupying a responsible official position.
sections.plain_language_summary: Electronic records, emails, WhatsApp chats, and digital receipts are admissible as evidence in court when accompanied by an electronic certificate.
